name: Mahatma Gandhi Rocks
look: A black-and-white photo of Mahatma Gandhi, bald with round wire glasses and a gray mustache, smiling warmly on the left side of a black background. Bold white text in the bottom right corner credits him by name, leaving empty black space for a quote.
use: A fake inspirational quote. People type a silly, modern or obviously made-up saying in the black space, and the solemn attribution to Gandhi makes it sound like timeless wisdom, which is the joke.
slots: the fake quote, in the black space to the right of his face
examples: Be the change you wish to see in the vending machine.
Always check the fridge one more time. Something new may have appeared.
